plugin_desc: Juniper SRX firewall SNMP collection (JUNIPER-SRX5000-SPU-MONITORING-MIB, IANA PEN 2636). Collects per-SPU CPU and memory utilization (jnxJsSPUMonitoringCPUUsage / jnxJsSPUMonitoringMemoryUsage, both 0-100 percent) plus current and maximum flow sessions (jnxJsSPUMonitoringCurrentFlowSession / jnxJsSPUMonitoringMaxFlowSession), optionally tagged by jnxJsSPUMonitoringNodeDescr. Interface counters come from the built-in IF-MIB catalog, not this plugin. Distinct from Switch Juniper SNMP (snmp_juniper) and Router Juniper MX SNMP (snmp_juniper_mx). Supported models — Juniper SRX series firewalls.
name: Firewall

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU utilization of each Juniper SRX Services Processing Unit (jnxJsSPUMonitoringCPUUsage) as a 0-100 percentage. Dimension index is the SPU monitoring table row; node_descr is the optional SPU node description. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate inspection overload or attack traffic.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports memory utilization of each Juniper SRX Services Processing Unit (jnxJsSPUMonitoringMemoryUsage, a direct percent value). High memory pressure on an SPU can degrade session handling.

metrics.name: firewall_active_sessions
metrics.description: Number of flow sessions currently tracked by each Juniper SRX SPU (jnxJsSPUMonitoringCurrentFlowSession). A rapid rise can indicate a connection flood or session-table pressure.

metrics.name: firewall_max_sessions
metrics.description: Maximum flow-session capacity of each Juniper SRX SPU (jnxJsSPUMonitoringMaxFlowSession). Combined with active sessions it gauges remaining session-table headroom.
